result.summary: The page is largely functional, but a raw localization key is rendered as a section heading, and there are a few smaller consistency/layout inconsistencies in the restaurant cards and category chips.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated label such as 'Popular near you'. This is user-visible placeholder/debug text in a primary heading.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the active locale and add a fallback so untranslated keys render a readable default rather than the key path.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two restaurant cards use inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background while the second has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, opacity and icon color) across all cards, or make it depend consistently on image contrast for all cards.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel's third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped by the screen edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek width and ellipsis truncation for titles, so the partially visible card clearly signals scrollability without cutting text arbitrarily.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge (a partial chip is visible past 'Healthy'), which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same peek/padding rule used for other carousels and consider a subtle fade or gradient mask at the edge.

issues.description: The bottom promo/pizza card is abruptly cut by the bottom navigation bar without any visible scroll indicator or bottom content inset.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully clear of the navigation.
